AdvisoryArtifactDescriptorV1.description: Authorized immutable artifact metadata; it never embeds artifact content.

classification.description: Data handling class enforced by artifact reads.

organization_id.description: Tenant owning the descriptor and payload authorization.

ecosystem.description: Canonical ecosystem vocabulary, not a provider SDK enum.

range_type.description: Version-range scheme and version retained verbatim after validation.

ContextQualifiedId.description:
A canonical `<context>_<opaque>` reference.

Context names are lowercase ASCII slugs. Opaque components are deliberately
restricted to lowercase base36-compatible text so comparison is stable
across databases, filesystems, and URL encoders.

DataClass.description: Platform-wide data sensitivity labels ordered from least to most sensitive.

oneOf.description: Non-public operational metadata with low disclosure impact.
Security-sensitive data requiring the strongest payload controls.

SchemaName.description: A reverse-DNS schema name owned by a Cauterizer bounded context.

SchemaVersion.description:
A canonical semantic schema version.

Build metadata is forbidden because it is ignored by semantic-version
precedence and would allow distinct envelope identifiers for the same version.

SeverityV1.description: Severity retaining metric and revision provenance.

vector.description: Validated vector or source-native score representation.

UtcInstant.description:
A canonical RFC 3339 UTC instant.

Only `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z` is accepted. Offsets, spaces, leap
seconds, lowercase separators, and fractional trailing zeroes are rejected so
equal instants have one wire representation. Fractional precision is limited
to nanoseconds.

description: Immutable normalized snapshot safe for downstream selection.

aliases.description: Sorted aliases; ambiguity is represented rather than auto-merged.

observed_at.description: Canonical snapshot time supplied by the application clock.

snapshot_id.description: Immutable snapshot identity; updates create a new identity.

source_observation_id.description: Stable source observation identity without upstream types.
